text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We have a little bit of time before<n>training starts, so
Seeking the Pearl<n>and I watch a TV special on train
station bento boxes together in the<n>meantime.

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Well, we certainly feasted our eyes<n>upon a number
of delicious-looking<n>bentos today! Until next week!
choice_data_list:
All right, guess it's about time we get started on
training.

All right, guess it's about time we get started on
training.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, Trainer! Before that, I want to<n>ask you about
making some changes<n>to my routine!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We need to put the spotlight on one<n>thing and one
thing only!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Think back on all of those bento<n>boxes we just
saw and how brightly<n>they shone... They were all
unified by<n>one main dish!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Just like a charismatic person<n>who excites the
crowd and creates<n>waves...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The possibilities are endless when<n>you hone one
thing to perfection!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Grilled malted pork, whole grilled<n>seafood... Each
bento had different<n>local specialities that accented
the<n>meal.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
One day, those side dishes will evolve<n>from mere
accents to main<n>attractions! And my body is no
different—what an exciting thought!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I understand her correctly, she must<n>want to
focus on one type of training<n>until it's perfectly
honed before<n>moving on to the next.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Let's get started, then! My<n>possibilities may
be infinite, but time<n>certainly is not!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her bento box analogy is a bit hard to<n>follow, but
she has a point. I decide to<n>take her motivation into
account and<n>make a new training routine for her.
